

// package main




fn main( ) -> (()) {
    
        

let rt = tokio::runtime::Builder::new_current_thread().build().unwrap();




rt.block_on(async {




let (tx, mut rx) = tokio::sync::mpsc::channel::<String>(1);




tx.send(String::from("message")).await.unwrap();




drop(tx);





while let Some(text) = (rx).recv().await {
    

print!("received {}", text);



}










print!("after closure");




});



    
}
